preregistered_analysis.C: C(arm) = median over cells of dM_main - dM_round; C_h the same over host h's cells
preregistered_analysis.S: S(arm) = #cells where the donor-new-source patch is JOINT and the donor-ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not (target host new)
preregistered_analysis.SPEC: SPEC iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
preregistered_analysis.SUF: SUF(arm) iff S(arm) >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(arm)
preregistered_analysis.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round, median dM and C per arm; S and C per host; observed and predicted S per host, s and w; leave-one-donor-group-out of every verdict; shift weight stats; change norm of every arm relative to full
preregistered_analysis.attribution: always reported per responsive host, s and w: main JOINT count, round JOINT count among the main-JOINT cells, round A > 0 and M > 0 counts, main and round median A and M, observed and predicted
preregistered_analysis.consistency_gate: full = the M3 all-heads patch: its 208 rows equal M3's bitwise and S(full) = 51; meanD_host = the M6 pooled-donor arm: its 208 rows equal M6's bitwise and S = 39 (GPU, checked in the run); abc_s0375 = M14's AB arm and csc29_s0375 = M15's all-position c-29 arm (same patch fields) on the 6 subset cells: their 2 x 12 rows equal M14's / M15's bitwise; mw0_s0375 (shift_pos_weight 0 at 13-28) on the same 12 rows equals abc_s0375 bitwise; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT_WITH_M3_M6_M14_M15 and no claim
preregistered_analysis.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: W_LINEAR HOLDS: within w in [-1, 3/2] each cell's M and A move linearly in the weight of the common shift at 13-28, so the AB / all-position difference in S, and M14's lower AB threshold, is the threshold readout of a linear per-cell, per-source effect of that shift on M and A; it is not evidence of a contrast component carried by the author and block lines. FAILS: the middle shift interacts non-linearly with the rest of the patch, and the two endpoints do not describe the intermediate patches. S_C_DISSOCIATE on a host: lowering the middle weight raises S while it lowers C, so on that host S at a fixed s ranks arms opposite to the contrast they carry; ALIGNED: they agree. All arms except full are pooled-donor arms (effectively 8 host replicates, 3 responding); per-host S is the honest unit; comparisons with M14 / M15 rows are valid because the replay arms are bitwise equal
preregistered_analysis.linear_prediction: for every M16 dose arm, cell and source, M_pred and A_pred = (1 - w) x the w = 0 row + w x the w = 1 row (M = conflict margin, A = action margin), computed in the freeze from the pinned rows and stored under linear_predictions; JOINT_pred = M_pred > 0 and A_pred > 0; S_pred as S. Per responsive host: AGREE = share of the 13 x 2 x 3 x 4 = 312 (cell, source, s, w) JOINT decisions where observed = predicted; dS = S_obs - S_pred per (s, w). LINEAR_HOLDS iff AGREE >= 0.95 and max |dS| <= 1; LINEAR_FAILS iff AGREE < 0.90 or max |dS| >= 3; else LINEAR_APPROX. LIN_BY_HOST lists the three hosts; pooled W_LINEAR: HOLDS iff every responsive host HOLDS, FAILS iff any FAILS, else APPROX. Reported as well, not verdicts: AGREE and max |dS| for w = 1/2 alone (interpolation) and for w = -1, -1/2, 3/2 (extrapolation); R^2 and median |error| of M and A against the prediction per host
preregistered_analysis.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run capture of host new)
preregistered_analysis.responsive_host: a host where S(cs1) on its cells exceeds half its cells, with cs1 read from the pinned M13 raw rows (1fb5651c, 264c458d, 4bcbaf15 in M13-M15)
preregistered_analysis.size_gate: every dose arm records shift weight min / max = min(w, 1) / max(w, 1) and the listed weight w; abc_s0375, csc29_s0375, mw0 and every mw arm set c_30 to 0 exactly
preregistered_analysis.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1-M6; cells share donors and hosts, and the pooled-mean arms vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 hosts), so counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests; per-host S is always reported
preregistered_analysis.w_family: for s in 1/4, 3/8, 1/2 and w in -1, -1/2, 0, 1/2, 1, 3/2: the common shift (t = 1) at all 31 span positions with the positions 13-28 multiplied by w, contrast -+ s/2 c with c_30 weight 0. w = 0 is M14 abc_<s> (pinned M14 rows), w = 1 is M15 csc29_<s> (pinned M15 rows), the other w are M16 mw<tag>_<s>
preregistered_analysis.w_trend: per responsive host and s, over the 6 w in increasing order, of host S and of host C: NO_EFFECT iff all equal; OPPOSES iff non-increasing and first > last; SUPPORTS iff non-decreasing and first < last; PEAKED iff non-decreasing up to the first maximum, non-increasing after it, and both ends below the maximum; else MIXED (prefix WS_ for S, WC_ for C). DISSOC_BY_HOST: over the s where WS is not NO_EFFECT, S_C_DISSOCIATE iff at every such s WC = SUPPORTS and WS in {OPPOSES, PEAKED}; S_C_ALIGNED iff at every such s WS = WC in {SUPPORTS, OPPOSES}; UNINFORMATIVE iff no such s; else S_C_MIXED
